content.comment_body: Hello! I would like to know if it's possible to connect a Sitrans TW device directly to the analog input of a [product_name], or if I need to use an [product_name] module specifically designed for PT100 sensors. Additionally, is Sitrans TW appropriate for measuring the temperature of a 5KVA power generator?

Are there any affordable temperature sensors available that are compatible with the analog inputs of [product_name]? I am trying to avoid using the [product_name] PT100 module, since I want to utilize all inputs on my [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for guidance on connecting a Sitrans TW temperature measurement device to the analog inputs on a [product_name] controller for monitoring a 5KVA generator. They are concerned about compatibility and prefer to avoid using a dedicated [product_name] PT100 module. Cost considerations and efficient input usage are important, with interest in alternative temperature sensors that would not require extra input channels.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for simple and direct integration of Sitrans TW with the analog inputs of the [product_name] controller, without needing additional modules. They also expect suggestions for inexpensive and compatible temperature sensors that help conserve analog input resources.
